readme:
# Buf

Protocol Buffers support powered by [Buf](https://buf.build) and its language server: syntax highlighting, diagnostics, hover, go to definition, completion and formatting for `.proto` files, plus `buf` commands from the command palette.

The extension needs the `buf` CLI. When it is not on your `PATH`, the extension downloads the matching release from GitHub into its own storage on first start, so it works with no setup. To use a specific install, set `buf.commandLine.path`.

This is the unmodified extension published on Open VSX, pinned to a specific version and verified to work in Diode.

## What works in Diode

The language server end to end: problems as you type, hover with the message's doc comment, F12 to the declaration, completion and Format Document. Imports of the well-known types (`google/protobuf/timestamp.proto` and friends) resolve out of the box. The status bar shows the Buf version, and `Buf: Show Buf Output` shows what the extension did.

Commands verified in Diode: `Buf: Init`, `Buf: Build`, `Buf: Start/Stop Buf Language Server`.

## What does not

`Buf: List available lint rules` and `Buf: List available breaking change detection rules` show their output in a new untitled document. Diode cannot create such a document from an extension yet, so both commands only log an error to Output → Buf. Run `buf config ls-lint-rules` / `buf config ls-breaking-rules` in the terminal instead.
